title: Make the suite independent of where TMPDIR points
lead:
AGENTS.md tells contributors to run the suite with `TMPDIR="$PWD/.venv/test-tmp"`, and
following that instruction fails 28 tests.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
AGENTS.md documents an in-checkout temp directory so test files stay inside the project:
`TMPDIR="$PWD/.venv/test-tmp" python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests`. Running
that today fails 28 tests across `test_cli`, `test_ready`, `test_ai`, `test_find`,
`test_goals`, `test_status` and `test_merge`. The tests are correct and the tool is
correct; the two just disagree about the fixture's location. Each fixture project is
created under `TMPDIR`, so with that setting it lands inside the checkout, and slicer's
cross-checkout code warning (`_CODE_WARNING_ENV` in `src/slicer/cli.py:1847`) reasonably
concludes the project is "a different worktree of the same repo" than the `src/` being
run. The warning goes to stderr, and these tests assert stderr is empty. With the default
`TMPDIR` the suite is green, so the failures are an artifact of the documented command,
not a regression. A contributor who follows AGENTS.md sees 28 red tests on a clean
checkout and has no way to tell that from a real break. This is separate from S125, which
is about the `verify` render-driver warning.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `tests/support.py` (`TempRepo.run`, which calls `main()` in-process)
- `AGENTS.md` (the documented test command, and the `SLICER_NO_CODE_WARNING` note at line 52)
- `src/slicer/cli.py` only if the detector's gating is the thing that should change

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
1. The full suite passes with `TMPDIR="$PWD/.venv/test-tmp"` set, exactly as AGENTS.md
   documents it.
2. The full suite still passes with the default `TMPDIR`.
3. A test that deliberately exercises the cross-checkout warning still sees it, so the
   fix does not blanket-suppress the behavior S117 added.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Settle the approach with the project before building; do not infer. The leading candidate
is to have `tests/support.py` set `SLICER_NO_CODE_WARNING=1` around its in-process `main()`
call, so fixture location never leaks into assertions and the suite is reproducible
wherever `TMPDIR` points — with any test that covers the warning itself opting back in
explicitly. Alternatives to weigh: drop the in-checkout `TMPDIR` advice from AGENTS.md and
document why; or narrow the detector so a project under a worktree's ignored scratch
directory is not treated as a sibling checkout. Prefer the fix that keeps the documented
command working, since the doc exists to keep test files out of the system temp dir.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Suite green both with and without the in-checkout `TMPDIR`; `slicer check` passes; AGENTS.md
and the code agree about how the suite is run.
